## Install (fresh)

1. Download `handoff.exe` from this release.
2. Put it on PATH or wherever you keep portable tools. There's no installer.
3. Run `handoff new` in a terminal and send the printed URL to whoever is helping you.

It uses the relay at <https://handoff.whyknot.dev/> unless `HANDOFF_RELAY` names another one. The [README](https://github.com/{full-repo}#install) has the full steps.
